title: Vibrant Golden Thai Kabocha Kanom Ko
description: A salty, cheese-pull, adventurous Thai dish featuring kabocha, served on toast in an iron teppan, jain-friendly and formed into kanom ko.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium heat.
In a large bowl, toss the diced kabocha squash with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Add the squash mixture to the preheated teppan and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the squash is tender and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix the Thai red curry paste with 1 tablespoon of water to make a paste.
Add the curry paste, diced onion, and minced garlic to the teppan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the onion is translucent.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine with the curry paste mixture.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in the vegan mozzarella shreds until they are melted and the sauce is smooth.
To assemble the kanom ko, place a toasted bread slice on the teppan, spoon some of the squash and sauce mixture on top, and use a spatula to shape into a kanom ko form.
